title: High precision simulations of the longest common subsequence problem
key_contribution: Introduces multi-spin coding technique for LCS, processing 64 string pairs per machine word; achieves high-precision γ₂ estimates

title: Mining Bit-Parallel LCS-length Algorithms
key_contribution: Systematic exploration of bit-parallel LCS algorithms; provides foundation for multi-spin extensions

title: Improved Lower Bounds on the Expected Length of Longest Common Subsequences
key_contribution: Implements parallelization and efficient memory schemes for lower bound computation; demonstrates that computational optimization directly improves mathematical bounds
